contribution.method: Exact recursive whole-solid composition of a four-owner triakis-tetrahedron base, and finite marked lattice-return constructions for the other families. Source lattices are reconstructed in the canonical solid frames, with infinite nonoverlap verified before taking finite patches. Complete boundary-controller deletions retain their predecessor configurations. Published source cells, including de Graaf and collaborators, are credited in the individual records. The archive retains complete native coordinates, explicit physical construction decoders, original source and donor credits, independent geometry and construction reviews, and SHA256 manifests. All 32 witnesses pass the unmodified upstream floating checker and exact certifier.
